description: Source code implementing PKCS#12 file generation and encryption using mbedtls library, including functions for encoding certificates and keys, and creating PKCS#12 structures.

classes.name: pkcs12_ctx
classes.description: Context structure for PKCS#12 encoding, holding buffers, cryptographic parameters, and state flags.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_tag
methods.description: Writes ASN.1 tag and length to buffer.

methods.name: uc_p12_enc_setup
methods.description: Sets up encryption cipher with derived key.

methods.name: uc_p12_enc_legacy
methods.description: Legacy encryption setup using older derivation method.

methods.name: uc_p12_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts buffer data with configured cipher.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_cert
methods.description: Adds a certificate to PKCS#12 structure from PEM string.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_key
methods.description: Adds a private key to PKCS#12 structure from mbedtls_pk_context resource.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_authsafe
methods.description: Adds the authSafe content, including certificates and keys.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_mac_digest_info
methods.description: Adds MAC digest info ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: uc_generate_pkcs12
methods.description: Main function to generate a PKCS#12 structure from input object, including password, certificates, and keys.
